research_lane: PR195 source vs occupancy distinction, exploratory previously exposed 2009-2018 author observations

frozen_early_target_site.warning: fixed approximate colony centroid; platform may move spatially within local buffer

independent_archive.file_size_context: Approximately 500 megabytes each; do not download unbounded multiannual files.
independent_archive.product_scope: 24 composites per March–February Antarctic year, 1km polar stereographic, 15-day approximate
independent_archive.no_year_2018_autumn_overflow: Dataset ends February 2018; no 2018 Austral winter

allow_network_ops: HTTP HEAD for exact frozen named annual files
HTTP Range request only bytes=0-31 per annual file
inspect Content-Length Content-Range Accept-Ranges and file format magic only
readiness_only.if_range_http_200: Stop without reading body, server may ignore Range.
readiness_only.if_host_unreachable: Record source unavailable; do NOT infer no ice.
readiness_only.if_no_http_range: Stop before download; only separate explicitly authorized bounded source extraction could proceed.
readiness_only.if_netCDF3_or_HDF5_signature: Only indicate possible remote chunk interpretation; requires separate protocol before actual physical data read.

future_exposure_if_remote_readiness_pass.chosen_windows: Composite whose END date precedes the author image date where available, plus nearest 15-day composite as sensitivity. No post-observation maps used as pre-decision exposure.
future_exposure_if_remote_readiness_pass.primary_comparison: external fractional landfast ice within 3km of frozen Ledda centroid in comparable relevant seasonal windows
future_exposure_if_remote_readiness_pass.counterfactual_tests: Compare independent physical ice in documented author available-vs-absent years, accounting for image date and actual platform location.
invalid_assumptions: fast ice present snapshot = viable through full breeding season
near-centroid fast ice = continuous walkable path
author no birds = no breeders all season
difference at one site = inferred social choice
